hypothesis: Field-C improved semantic directions but its unconstrained per-primitive feature norms moved the frozen nonlinear readout away from its calibrated input gauge.

fixed_method.semantic_direction: L2-normalized Field-C decoded feature per primitive
fixed_method.amplitude: L2 norm of the same primitive in the immutable initial canonical field
fixed_method.projection: least-squares encoding through the fixed Field-C affine decoder

legacy_safety_compatibility: The gauge reference predates the top-level benchmark_images_opened flag; compatibility requires its bound mpr_cache_metadata.benchmark_images_opened to be explicitly false. All other missing safety fields fail closed.

sentinel.continue_rule: Expand only if AP is non-decreasing within 0.002 absolute and at least two of fixed mIoU, Otsu mIoU, fixed purity, or Otsu purity improve over Field-C.
sentinel.stop_rule: Reject gauge projection if AP decreases by more than 0.002 or both fixed and Otsu mIoU decrease.
